facts.fact: ANSUT's director-general said President Ouattara launched the 'nos villages connectes' programme to connect more than 500 rural localities, adding that many areas remain to be connected; no count of localities connected is given.

systems.system: ANSUT (Agence nationale du service universel des telecommunications et des TIC)

CIV.note: No budget amount, own-resources statement or spending figure stated.

facts.fact: Abidjan hosted SUTEL 2025, the African Telecommunications Union's regional universal service workshop, on 25 to 28 August 2025, which ended with a memorandum of understanding signed between the ATU and Cote d'Ivoire's ANSUT on cooperation among universal service fund managers.
